actions.description: Publish a photo to a Facebook Page.
actions.name: create-page-photo

pageId.description: The Facebook Page ID to post the photo to. Example: "1148671018324630"

url.description: The URL of the photo to upload. Example: "https://example.com/photo.jpg"

caption.description: Caption text for the photo. Example: "Check out our new product!"

published.description: Whether the photo should be published immediately. Set to false to create an unpublished photo (draft). Defaults to true.

id.description: The ID of the created photo.

postId.description: The ID of the post associated with the photo (if published).

actions.description: Publish a post to a Facebook Page feed.
actions.name: create-page-post

pageId.description: Facebook Page ID to post to. Example: "1148671018324630"

message.description: The message content of the post.

link.description: URL to share in the post.

published.description: Whether to publish immediately (true) or schedule (false). Default: true

scheduledPublishTime.description: Unix timestamp for scheduled post publishing. Required if published=false.

id.description: The ID of the created post.

actions.description: Publish a video to a Facebook Page.
actions.name: create-page-video

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID to upload the video to. Example: "1148671018324630"

file_url.description: URL of the video to upload. Must be a publicly accessible URL. Example: "https://example.com/video.mp4"

description.description: Description or message for the video post.

published.description: Whether the video should be published immediately. Set to false to create a draft. Defaults to true.

post_id.description: The ID of the post that was created for this video.

actions.description: Create a comment on a Facebook post
actions.name: create-post-comment

pageId.description: The ID of the page that owns the post. Example: "1148671018324630"

postId.description: The ID of the post to comment on. Example: "1148671018324630_122098284213327930"

message.description: The comment text message. Example: "Great post!"

actions.description: Schedule a future post on a Facebook Page
actions.name: create-scheduled-page-post

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID to post on. Example: "123456789012345"

message.description: The message text for the post

scheduled_publish_time.description: Unix timestamp when the post should be published. Must be at least 10 minutes and at most 6 months in the future.

link.description: URL to attach to the post

photo_url.description: URL of a photo to attach to the post

id.description: The ID of the scheduled post

actions.description: Delete a Facebook comment by comment ID
actions.name: delete-comment

commentId.description: Facebook comment ID to delete. Example: "122098284213327930_1544841897156600"

pageId.description: The Facebook Page ID that owns the comment. Required when the user manages multiple pages to ensure the correct page token is used. Example: "1148671018324630"

actions.description: Delete a Facebook Page post by post ID
actions.name: delete-post

postId.description: The ID of the Facebook post to delete. Example: "1148671018324630_122098284213327930"

actions.description: Retrieve a Facebook comment by comment ID.
actions.name: get-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve. Example: "122098284213327930_1544841897156600"

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Example: "id,message,created_time,from,like_count"

pageId.description: The Facebook Page ID that owns the comment. Required when the user manages multiple pages to ensure the correct page token is used. Example: "1148671018324630"

actions.description: Retrieve app subscriptions configured on a Facebook Page
actions.name: get-page-app-subscriptions

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each subscribed app. Example: "id,name,link,subscribed_fields"

data.description: List of apps subscribed to the page

next.description: URL for the next page of results

actions.description: Retrieve Facebook Page metadata by page ID
actions.name: get-page

actions.description: Retrieve a Facebook post by post ID
actions.name: get-post

post_id.description: The ID of the Facebook post to retrieve. Example: "1148671018324630_122098284213327930"

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Example: "id,message,created_time,from"

actions.description: Retrieve the authenticated Facebook user profile or another accessible user object.
actions.name: get-user-profile

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Example: "id,name,email,picture"

actions.description: List posts from a Facebook Page feed.
actions.name: list-page-posts

since.description: Unix timestamp or ISO date. Posts created after this time.

until.description: Unix timestamp or ISO date. Posts created before this time.

limit.description: Number of posts to return per page. Max 100.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include. Example: "id,message,created_time,permalink_url"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List scheduled posts for a Facebook Page
actions.name: list-page-scheduled-posts

limit.description: Maximum number of scheduled posts to return. Default: 25

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List videos published on a Facebook Page
actions.name: list-page-videos

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Default: 25

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Example: "id,title,description,created_time,source"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List comments on a Facebook post with pagination support
actions.name: list-post-comments

postId.description: The post ID to list comments for. Example: "1148671018324630_122098284213327930"

filter.description: Filter for comments. "toplevel" (default) returns top-level comments only. "stream" returns all comments including replies.

order.description: Order of comments. "chronological" = oldest first, "reverse_chronological" = newest first.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List Facebook Pages the authenticated user can access
actions.name: list-user-pages

accessToken.description: Page access token for API calls

pages.description: List of Facebook Pages accessible to the user

actions.description: Subscribe the app to receive updates for a Facebook Page
actions.name: subscribe-app-to-page

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID to subscribe the app to. Example: "1148671018324630"

subscribed_fields.description: Array of webhook event types to subscribe to. Example: ["feed", "messages", "mention", "name", "picture"]

actions.description: Remove the app subscription from a Facebook Page
actions.name: unsubscribe-app-from-page

syncs.description: Sync posts from Facebook Pages the connection can access.
syncs.name: page-posts

syncs.description: Sync scheduled unpublished posts for Facebook Pages in scope
syncs.name: page-scheduled-posts

syncs.description: Sync videos published on Facebook Pages in scope.
syncs.name: page-videos

syncs.description: Sync Facebook Pages the authenticated user can access
syncs.name: pages
